description.plain:
Use Case & Business Problem	Enterprise Intake & Problem Space

Industry / User Persona — Target Industries: Discrete & Process Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Wholesale Distribution, Utilities & Enterprise Services.
User Personas: Enterprise Master Data Requester, Data Steward / Governance Specialist,
Financial Controller, and SAP System Administrator.

Problem (3 bullets) — Fragmented Intake Across Channels: Master-data change requests arrive via unstandardized spreadsheets, emails, and tickets with zero schema governance.
High ERP Error Rates & Rework: Manual Excel uploads frequently contain invalid lookup codes, malformed tax/bank fields, and duplicate business keys, directly corrupting S/4HANA core transactions.
Governance & Audit Deficits: Legacy ABAP workflows lack temporal versioning, dynamic approver determination, mandatory remarks enforcement, and transparent audit trails.

description.plain:
Central Master Data Workspace	Operational UI Console

Caption — Master-data workspace for controlled record maintenance ( zmdr_cntrl_main ).

Callouts (Up to 3) — Functional Area & Entity Navigation: Switch dynamically between Customer, Materials, and Services to load entity catalogs (e.g. Business Partner) with zero UI recoding.
Multi-Filter Query & Result Set: Drill down by Business Partner ID, Type, Role, Category, Country, and Status, viewing live records with instant status indicators.
Role-Based Action Ribbon: Contextual actions ( + Create , edit, mass upload, export)
adjust dynamically based on XSUAA scopes ( MDR_Requestor , MDR_Approver ).

description.plain:
Result

Headline Metric — 75% Faster Request Turnaround (Cycle time reduced from 4.5 days to under 4 hours)

Before → After — Before: Master data requests arrived across uncoordinated emails and spreadsheets; manual validation caused high error rates; updates took 4–7 days with zero audit visibility.
After: Unified self-service portal on SAP BTP; pre-commit automated schema and relational checking; multi-tier BPA approval routing with single-click promotion to S/4HANA.
